pull_requests.title: Setup initial FastAPI routers and models
pull_requests.author: Asha
pull_requests.body: Implements core database schema and FastAPI CRUD routers for events and attendee registrations.
comments: Deepak: Looks clean. Ensure WAL mode is active in db setup.

pull_requests.title: Add Google Calendar event integration
pull_requests.author: Asha
pull_requests.body: Allows students to sync registered campus events with Google Calendar using the service account key in keys/service_account.json.
comments: Ravi: Verified service account works in staging.

pull_requests.title: Switch auth tokens to HTTP-only secure cookies
pull_requests.author: Asha
pull_requests.body: Replaces localStorage token storage with HTTP-only SameSite cookies to protect student session tokens from XSS vulnerabilities.
comments: Deepak: Approved. Critical for campus security compliance.

pull_requests.title: Add multi-tier ticket tiering and student discounts
pull_requests.author: Asha
pull_requests.body: WIP: Introducing VIP and General Admission ticket tiers with student discount validation. Still needs automated tests and migration script.
comments: Deepak: Asha, please resolve the merge conflict in app/api/discounts.py before you depart.

pull_requests.title: Enforce auditorium capacity check of 350 seats
pull_requests.author: Neha
pull_requests.body: Limits auditorium bookings to 350 seats based on the updated Student Affairs seating chart.
comments: Deepak: Hold on, didn't architecture_overview.md specify maximum capacity is 500? We need to verify which count is valid.

issues.title: Bulk email dispatch occasionally drops last 10 recipients
issues.author: Arun
issues.body: When dispatching announcement emails to batches over 50 users, the background task times out and truncates the final 10 recipients without error logs.
comments: Asha: Identified SMTP connection reuse issue. Needs connection pooling in services/mailer.py.

issues.title: Worker OOM on PDF generation during orientation week
issues.author: Ravi
issues.body: The Celery worker crashes with Out of Memory error when 100+ badges are generated concurrently in ReportLab.
comments: Asha: We should batch generation into chunks of 25.

issues.title: Database is locked errors when 200+ students register simultaneously
issues.author: Deepak
issues.body: SQLite throws operational error 'database is locked' during peak registration spikes even with WAL mode active.
comments: Ravi: We need to increase timeout to 15 seconds in SQLite connect args.

issues.title: Render deploy fails on missing build dependencies
issues.author: Ravi
issues.body: Render build step failed because libpq-dev was missing from minimal image.
